question: Who among the following Indian grandmasters won the India's first ever silver medal at FIDE World Rapid and Blitz Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Koneru Humpy.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Koneru Humpy:-**

 
 
• She won the India's first ever silver medal at FIDE World Rapid and Blitz Championship 2022.
 
• She is a renowned Indian chess grandmaster who has won several accolades and titles in her career. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Harika Dronavalli:-**

 
 
• She is another Indian chess grandmaster who has won several international tournaments and represented India in the Chess Olympiad.
 
 
 
• **Bhakti Kulkarni:-**
 
 
• She is an Indian chess player who has won several national and international tournaments and is a former National Women's Premier Chess Champion.
 
 
 
• **Tania Sachdev:- **
 
 
• She is an Indian chess player who has won several international tournaments and represented India in the Chess Olympiad.
 
 
 
• **FIDE World Rapid and Blitz Championship:-**
 
 
• It is an international chess tournament organized by the World Chess Federation (FIDE) where players compete in rapid and blitz chess games.
